digest.component_or_area: plan review, Pass-1 single-turn criteria and container routing
propositions: Acceptance criteria across a plan and its children can be mutually unsatisfiable (contradictory universal quantifications vs. carve-outs, derived-artifact closure violations, or snapshot cardinality mismatches), yet Pass-1 certification currently finds zero blocking findings because no criterion owns that concern, forcing late detection and full LLM re-reviews.

A new 1-TURN advisory criterion `ac-satisfiability` in facet `coherence` must detect joint unsatisfiability of a ticket's own AC and Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations via the set-quantification primitive (universal-vs-carve-out, derived-artifact closure, snapshot cardinality shapes), filling a gap between COH (section contradictions only) and E1/F1 (criterion form).

The sibling roster sent to G3's child-coverage audit carries only child ids and titles, so G3 cannot discharge its test that no sibling covers each parent AC; the roster must be enriched with each child's acceptance-criteria items extracted via `evaluate_plan_clarity(...).ac_items` and rendered indented beneath each child's id:title line.

Three independent copies of the roster-building expression exist (pass1.py:154, fidelity_spot_eval.py:219, eval_solver.py:117-119); they must be single-sourced into one `build_sibling_roster(children)` helper in pass1.py callable by all three, or the eval harnesses will send title-only rosters and corrupt the dogfooding data for G3's deferred posture decision.

The roster must move from per-pairing instructions into the system prompt's byte-stable prefix (concatenated after `_resolve_system(PASS_CONTAINER, ...)`) to avoid re-sending the child AC corpus once per pairing (quadratic blowup) and to make it cacheable; its token cost must be added to `parent_tokens` estimate so container bin-packing and the warm gate remain accurate.
